content.text: *Preferred agents for reducing agitation ← initiating an SSRI

– drowsiness · sedation · ataxia · lethargy · impaired psychomotor performance
•↑ anxiety: insomnia · confusion · difficulty concentrating · fatigue
dependence/tolerance (chronic use) · amnesia · CNS depression · abuse potential · elderly (fall risk)
use w opioids → sedation · resp depression · coma & death
Diazepam · midazolam · chlordiazepoxide: sig hepatic met → accumulation & prolonged effect in liver impairment
MOA: (+) allosteric modulator of GABA-A-r → ↑freq of Cl channel opening (vs phenobarb =↑duration)
Adj chronic ASM tx                           -    EToH w.draw (see below)
Acute dystonia: adjunct to anticholinergics (anxiety · musc rigidity)
Serotonin syndrome: Sx mgnt (w cyproheptadine) - ⍉consistently shown sig effect
Ménière dz: acute vertigo attacks (eg clonazepam · diazepam)
▪︎specific phobia: cautious situational use (eg airplane travel) of an immediate-acting antianxiety med
▪︎vertigo/labyrinthitis: short-term Sx control (primarily first 24–48 h) - alprazolam or diazepam
BDZ OD: supportive care - consider flumazenil only if severe sxs in BDZ-naive pts
Acute sz/status epilepticus: BZD as 1st-line abortive tx
Status epilepticus: +5 min cont sz activity OR ±2 discrete szs w.o post-ictal recovery
Focused exam (resp/circ status)   -   IV   -   blood draw   -    BG    -    O2
Labs: CBC    -    CMP    -   Mg/Ca/phos    -    LFTs    -    tox screen
1st line: lorazepam IV → diazepam IV/PR alt → midazolam IM if ⍉IV
Refractory: cont infuse propofol/midazolam/pentobarbital + cont EEG + neuro consult
Post-ictal phase: sz end → pre-sz baseline
Sx: confusion   -   ↓alert   -   focal neuro deficits   -   post-ictal paresis
Recovery avg 10–20 min                    -     Serial neuro exams
⍉baseline or neuro exam abnorm → head CT - septic - LP
MOA: BZDs stim GABA-r → ↓neuron activity + sedation
AWS = chronic EtOH ↑GABA tol & ⍉glut during use
cessation → unopposed glut excitation → CNS mayhem

w.in 12–24 hr of stop       -     EtOH levels ⍉0 to start
assoc w chronic abuse     -     Poss status epilepticus

Approach: Individualized - Sx-triggered (CIWA-Ar Q10–15 min → Q1–2h)
Minor sx: support + PO BZD               -    Progression/sz: IV
Risk strat: PAWSS (Predict EToH w.draw Severity Scale) = best for clin sig AWS
admin: 0.1 mg/kg IV, max rate 2 mg/min; max 4 mg/dose
alt to lorazepam if ⍉IV access: rectal
admin: IV or PR (rectal); 0.15–0.2 mg/kg IV (5–10 mg typical, max 10 mg/dose)
Admin: Short 1/2 life; 0.2 mg/kg IV or 10 mg IM (max 10 mg/dose)
MOA:  Compete w acetylcholine @ muscarinic-r in CNS
